content: निदृश् {%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To show, point out; निदर्शयामास विशेषदृश्यमिन्दुं नवोत्थानमिवेन्दुमत्यै <ls>R. 6. 31</ls>. .²2 To prove, establish, demonstrate. .²3 To consider, treat of, discuss (as in a book). .²4 To teach, explain. .²5 To illustrate by an example; <ab>cf.</ab> निदर्शना. .²6 To introduce, cause to enter. .²7 To show oneself to (a person).
